newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese parliament to vote on budget on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese parliament to vote on budget on Monday.

text.p: The Lebanese parliament put off until Monday a vote on a 6,433 billion pound ($4.15 billion) budget for 1997 after it failed to end debate by midnight on Saturday.
"The session will be resumed on Monday," Speaker Nabih Berri told parliament when a question-and-answer session with ministers on the budget dragged on until midnight.
The session is the final stage before voting.

Throughout the four-day debate which began on Wednesday, deputies criticised the government's proposed figures and said a planned tight deficit of 36 percent of revenue against spending was unrealistic.
Others said the government was sinking Lebanon in debt while failing to pursue a productive economic policy.
But the budget is expected to be approved easily because pro-government deputies dominate parliament.
